title: George Kittle is skeptical that Brandon Aiyuk will "get in" the team facility

sources.title: George Kittle is skeptical that Brandon Aiyuk will "get in" the team facility
sources.description: As 49ers receiver Brandon Aiyuk attempts to lay the foundation for a return to the NFL, at least one other 49ers player has expressed skepticism about Aiyuk's plan.
